$comment: Command bus registry (docs/spec/command-bus.md). DATA, not code: the kinds, their tier, who may start them, their typed args, the client classes and the limits. The Node executor reads extension/routes/bus/registry.json, which MUST stay byte-identical to this file (scripts/conformance-bus.mjs checks it; `node scripts/conformance-bus.mjs --sync` copies). The Mac tier gate (R-G1) can read this file later without porting a table. Schema keywords: type, properties, required, items, enum, const, additionalProperties, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum, x-format (id | provider | model | date).

phone-pwa.note: web client: read and queued low-risk chat only, never T0/T1/T2, never approvals

extension.note: the Chrome extension: read and chat on the Mac-managed server, no task start

ios-native.note: native phone: may start T0 and enqueue T1/T2 (which wait for a desktop click)

desktop-ui.note: the desktop UI: the only class that approves; proven by the host nonce

R.meaning: read-only, no write, no spend beyond a chat quota

C.meaning: chat under the fixed remote-safe ceiling

T0.meaning: auto-task kind with a read-only ceiling; needs the kind enabled, else a desktop approval

T1.meaning: enqueue only; waits for a desktop approval; permission re-checked at execution

T2.meaning: writes code or leaves the machine; desktop approval with the exact ids confirmed; never inherits Bypass

D.meaning: desktop-only: refused for every other class

review.description: Read-only review of a registered project (code, docs or merge conflicts) on a chosen engine.

sources.update.unavailableReason: Node has no source registry: connector credentials and source lists live in the Mac app (email, Slack) or are sent per request (Box); no server-side refresh exists to adapt.
sources.update.description: Fetch email, Slack and document sources into the Library and re-index.

issues.from_notes.unavailableReason: The deterministic note action extractor and the tracker allow-list live in the Mac app; Node has only the meeting planner, a different function.
issues.from_notes.description: Extract action items from recent notes and create upstream issues.

issues.implement.unavailableReason: No Node worktree runner or write-mode engine yet. codex and gemini write mode needs an explicit design and user decision (Swift runs them with --yolo, which disables their sandbox); never copied here.
issues.implement.description: Run an engine on approved issues in a worktree on a fix branch; optional ship (push, open MR/PR).

loop.run.unavailableReason: Loop definitions (stages, verify commands, scope) live in the Mac app; Node has only the confined agent step (POST /kb/loop/agent-run), which needs the composed stage prompt.
loop.run.description: Run one of the project's Loops (or one stage) with edits inside its declared scope.

custom.run.unavailableReason: Saved custom tasks (named prompt, cron, project) live in the Mac app; Node has no store to resolve a customTaskId.
custom.run.description: Run a saved custom task by id (the prompt is part of the saved task, never of the command).
